svg.text: The whole system at work: who gives an order, what the agents do, which files and tools they touch, how the tools call each other
Left to right: you speak only in chat; agents write plain files; tools read them, refuse what breaks a rule and run the suites; numbers come back as a verdict. Red borders refuse.
